name: slskd
description: A modern client-server application for the Soulseek file-sharing network with a web interface and reverse proxy support.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Persistent slskd configuration, database and application data. Must be writable by UID/GID 500:500.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Completed Soulseek downloads. Use the same host directory as SoulSync /app/downloads when integrating both applications.

ports.name: HTTPS Web UI
ports.description: slskd HTTPS web interface using its self-signed certificate.

variables.name: Remote Configuration
variables.description: Allow configuration changes from the Web UI. Disable this for untrusted or directly Internet-facing deployments.

variables.name: Downloads Directory
variables.description: Directory where completed downloads are stored.

variables.name: Shared Directory
variables.description: Directory shared through Soulseek. Multiple paths can be separated with semicolons.
